# proxies.minoa.cat

fast filtered proxy lists + user agent strings, served from cloudflare edge.
data refreshes hourly upstream. responses cached 300s (stale-while-revalidate 60s).

## docs

- machine spec (full filter/format reference): https://proxies.minoa.cat/docs.json
- interactive url builder: https://proxies.minoa.cat/
- user agent builder: https://proxies.minoa.cat/useragents.html
- always re-fetch /docs.json before generating urls. params change; docs.json is authoritative.

## repo and data

- repo: https://github.com/M1noa/proxypool
- site + worker code lives on orphan branch `pages-cache`
- proxy records: `output` branch, `proxies.json`
  raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/M1noa/proxypool/output/proxies.json
- user agent records: `output` branch, `useragents.json`
  raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/M1noa/proxypool/output/useragents.json
- prefer the edge api over raw github. use raw only for bulk/offline work.

## endpoints

- proxies: GET https://proxies.minoa.cat/list
- user agents: GET https://proxies.minoa.cat/uas
- stats: GET https://proxies.minoa.cat/stats and /ua-stats
- bare /list (no query) returns upstream proxies.json untouched. same for /uas.
- unknown params or bad values return 400 in the requested format. check status before parsing.

## residential proxies (isp)

residential means `ip_type=isp`. this is the closest the dataset gets to
residential. there is no `residential` value; `ip_type=residential` is a 400.

```
/list?ip_type=isp&format=jsonl
/isp.txt
/list?ip_type=isp&https=true&sort=quality&format=jsonl
/list?ip_type=isp&anonymity=elite&min_reliability=0.8&response_max=2000&sort=response&format=json
```

- shortcut `/isp.<txt|json|jsonl|csv>` pins `ip_type=isp`. other params still apply: `/isp.txt?country=us&limit=50`
- exclude datacenter: there is no NOT operator. pull isp + business + education_research + government_admin and filter client side, or just take isp.
- `ip_type` values: hosting, business, isp, education_research, government_admin, unknown. `unknown` means empty in the data.
- quality matters more than type here. stack filters: `ip_type=isp&min_quality=0.7&min_reliability=0.8&response_max=2000&sort=quality`
- verify client side: record fields `ip_type`, `as_org`, `asn`, `reliability`, `quality`, `response_time_ms`.

## scraping recipes

usable proxy, fastest first (default sort):
```
/list?type=http&anonymity=elite&min_reliability=0.8&response_max=2000&sort=response&format=txt&limit=100
```

socks5 pool:
```
/list?type=socks5&min_quality=0.5&sort=quality&format=txt
/socks5.txt?country=us,de&limit=50
```

per-country residential:
```
/list?ip_type=isp&country=us&sort=quality&format=jsonl&limit=200
```

fresh and fast:
```
/list?last_seen_after=2026-09-23T00:00:00Z&response_max=1000&sort=last_seen&format=csv
```

random sample (never cached, reshuffles every call):
```
/list?sort=random&limit=20&format=txt
```

## filter notes

- multi-value: repeat or comma: `?type=socks4&type=socks5` or `?type=socks4,socks5`. `any`/`all` clears the filter.
- txt shape depends on type count: exactly one type selected gives bare `ip:port` lines. zero or 2+ gives `protocol://ip:port`, one line per matched protocol.
- json/jsonl give full records (ip, port, protocols, country, anonymity, https, asn, as_org, ip_type, response_time_ms, reliability, quality, checks_total, checks_ok, sources, first_seen, last_seen, last_checked). use jsonl for streaming large pulls.
- csv joins array fields (protocols, sources) with `;`, RFC 4180 quoting.
- `https=true` means CONNECT support, not the proxy scheme. `type=https` is the scheme.
- `as_org` is a case-insensitive substring: `?as_org=comcast`. `asn` takes AS numbers: `?asn=7922,3352`.
- `min_reliability` 0..1 is lifetime check success rate. `min_quality` 0..1 is the composite score. start at 0.7/0.8 and loosen.
- `limit=0` (default) means no limit, capped at 1000000. always set limit for scripts.
- response headers: `X-Proxy-Count`, `X-Data-Age` (seconds since fetch), `X-Cache: HIT|MISS`.
- user agents: `/uas?browser=chrome&os=windows&format=json&limit=20`, shortcuts `/ua-chrome.txt`, `/ua-mobile.json`. pair a desktop chrome UA with a hosting proxy, mobile safari UA with isp, for plausible combos.
